name: 08-matcha-whisk-still-life
prompt:
Use case: compositing. Asset type: polished product catalog campaign image for 128am Cafe. Create ONE single photorealistic portrait 3:4 image, ideally 1200x1600, not a collage. Input image 1 is the edit target and strict packaging/product reference. Preserve this exact short clear tapered plastic takeaway cup, actual proportions, clear low lid and white crimped seal underneath, deep natural green matcha upper layer blending into pale matcha milk and white milk at the bottom; keep the drink as sold. Carefully preserve the sticker illustration: brown-haired girl with pink bow and apron, white bunny with exactly two ears, drink and whisk details, and legible 128am CAFE label. Make the logo sharp, aligned, faithful and recognizable; do not invent a new logo. Improve exposure, colour, realistic ice and fresh light condensation; appetising but believable, no neon green. Keep the entire cup including lid and base in frame, no new straw, toppings, fruit, cream or packaging. Commercial food photograph, convincing plastic transparency and real materials, natural dimensional shadows, not illustration or CGI. Brand palette cream #FFF8F5, rose #B8496C, pink #FDE5EB, sage #E7F0DC. Typography is the SAME across this series: large bold rounded lowercase Fredoka-style headline 'matcha latte' in warm cocoa or rose, centered at top in ample clear negative space; smaller exact '128am Cafe' beneath headline. Readable clean typography, at least 7% safe margins, no other copy, no price, claims, watermark or decorative fake labels.
Input image 2 is typography/layout style reference only; match its exact rose bold rounded heading and small centered brand line, while using photo 1 as source product.
Scene: Overhead / elevated three-quarter matcha preparation still life. Preserve actual cup shape and front branding, camera angled downward only moderately so sticker remains clearly visible, cup hero on cream tabletop. A bamboo matcha whisk and tiny shallow ceramic dish of green matcha powder sit behind cup, softly out of focus, never touching drink. Restrained sage and cream colours, gentle daylight, large clear top area for shared heading.
visual_qa: Passed: typography, entire cup, product gradient, logo girl and two-ear bunny, scene.
